author: gaxanh
content: The specification state gas will not be refunded via CREATE/SELFDESTRUCT. Currently, this is the only way to effectively create temporary accounts, as using REVERT would result in the loss of previously created progress.

author: chfast
content: This is fixable in 8037. I'd push for such solution. Adding TCREATE is unlikely because core devs are allergic to new EVM features.
